facts.text: I asked how discriminatory policies in the South impacted the decision of African Americans to migrate North during the Great Migration.
I said it is fascinating to learn about the impact discriminatory policies had on the Great Migration.
I asked whether the Great Migration helped improve race relations in the North.
I asked whether there were any negative consequences of the Great Migration.
I said it is interesting to see how the Great Migration impacted both the South and the North.
I said it is eye-opening to think about how much the Great Migration impacted the country as a whole.
I said I had no idea the Great Migration had such far-reaching consequences.
I said it is amazing how much impact one event can have on our entire country.
I said it makes me wonder what other history-changing events might be overlooked or not fully understood.
I agreed that it is important to continue learning about history and to stay informed about current events to make positive changes for the future.
I said we have a responsibility to better understand our past and present and work towards a better tomorrow.
